name: Invoke
description: invokes a function/operation of the given object and if given object is a string, Lucee tries to load as component.
syntax: Invoke( any object, string name, [any arguments] )

params.name: object
params.description:
a component, struct or scope that holds a function,

can also be the name of a component, in this case the component get loaded.

params.name: arguments
params.description: arguments to pass to the function/operation
